correctness.rationale: For Clebsch graph vertices F2^4 with XOR edges in {1,2,4,8,15}, an independently written finite-face enumerator finds augmented face vector 1,16,80,160,120,16, i.e. 392 nonempty independent faces. Reconstructing the stated pivot sequence yields 192 augmented pairs; removal of empty-face pair leaves 191 ordinary Morse pairs and exactly one critical 0-cell plus nine critical 3-cells. Independently oriented 1,200 nonempty Hasse edges and topologically sorted all 392 nodes, excluding cycles; Forman discrete Morse yields an integral wedge of nine S^3 with no torsion. The 1920 actions of T=F2^5/<all-ones> semidirect S5 were verified as graph automorphisms, and independent fixed-face signed Lefschetz sums match the sign-twisted standard 4 plus five character-weight module on every element; trace distribution {-5:20,-3:60,-1:884,1:865,3:80,5:10,9:1}, translation invariant dimension4, full group invariant dimension0. Character equality over Q and finite transfer justify quotient rational homology; no integral quotient or action splitting claimed.
